faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of CURAJ?
faq.answer: CURAJ stands for Central University of Rajasthan. It is a prominent central university located in Ajmer, Rajasthan, offering various academic programs and employment opportunities across diverse educational fields.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under CURAJ Faculty Resource Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the position of Faculty Resource Person (Science) under this recruitment drive for the Dr. Ambedkar Center of Excellence (DACE).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CURAJ Faculty Resource Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 31-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Faculty Resource Person post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Faculty Resource Person (Science) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG / M.Sc. degree in any discipline of Science or a B.Tech. degree in Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks, along with Civil Services Exam qualification and teaching experience.

faq.question: Q6. Through which portal can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the SAMARTH Portal accessible via the official website of the Central University of Rajasthan at www.curaj.ac.in.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required for CURAJ Faculty Resource Person Recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee details are specified in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official notification portal for any updates regarding fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CURAJ Faculty Resource Person (Science)?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: Yes, after submitting the online application, candidates must take a printout and send it with all necessary enclosures to the Recruitment Cell at CURAJ by 06-11-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central University of Rajasthan located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Rajasthan is located at NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, District Ajmer, Rajasthan, with the postal pincode 305817.
